title: Yellow triangle after changing transmitter, maybe no longer rellevant with the G7
body:
Hello

Yellow triangle as you know, displayed usually after replacing transmitter. 
The thing is, when using Dexcom G7, we replace transmitter (since it's one unit) every 10 days. There is no real need to display this yellow triangle anymore, or at least add this as an option for display if someone wants it... 

just a thought. 
thanks a lot!
